title: BIR Form No. 1600-PT — Monthly Remittance Return of Other Percentage Taxes Withheld

choice_rows.label: Item 12 — Availing of tax relief under a Special Law or International Tax Treaty?

atc.label: ATCs (tap to add or remove, at most five)

validation.how: Labels turn red via has_error; messages render only in the bottom card: body.child(self.section("Needs review", issues, cx)).

findings.field: ATCs (tap to add or remove, at most five)
findings.now: After five ATCs are ticked, tapping an unticked ATC adds nothing and the status line reads 'Select at most five ATCs (Items 13 to 17).', so a sixth ATC cannot be recorded.
findings.why: The official form takes a sixth ATC in its other-taxes table (tblPartIIOtherTax), so filers with more than five ATCs cannot finish this return in the app.

options.name: Other-taxes table
options.detail: Add a second Part II table for ATC 6 and up, with description, tax base and rate, mirroring the official tblPartIIOtherTax.

options.name: Block with a notice
options.detail: Show a notice that a sixth ATC must be filed in eBIRForms, and keep the in-app cap until the table is modelled.

options.name: Raise the cap
options.detail: Extend the model and the submit layout past five Part II rows once the other-taxes table is modelled.

findings.now: Changing the month on an open draft makes Save write a new draft for that month, and the draft opened from the tile keeps the old month and its data.
findings.why: Drafts are keyed by TIN, year and the monthly period column, so an edited month becomes a different row.

options.name: Lock the period
options.detail: Show Month and Year read-only once a draft exists, with a separate 'Start another month' action.

options.name: Move the same row
options.detail: On a month change, rekey the existing draft after a confirm step instead of inserting a second row.

options.name: Open the saved draft
options.detail: On a month change, load that month's saved draft, or create one, and say so in the status line.

findings.now: A blank Year box shows 'Year shall not be greater than the present year and not earlier than 2018.' instead of the required-field alert.
findings.why: The blank year becomes 0 and fails the range check first, while the official checkDate skips blanks and validateAll then raises 'Year field on Page 1 Item 1 is required.' (BIR-Form1600PTv2018.hta:2987).

options.name: Required check first
options.detail: Test for a blank year before the range check, as the official validateAll does.

options.name: Inline year message
options.detail: Show the required message under the Year box as well as in Needs review.

options.name: Numeric year control
options.detail: Use a numeric control limited to 2018 through the current year, so a blank never reaches the range check.

findings.now: A TIN or RDO error appears only in Needs review, while the Item 5 and Item 6 rows stay black and read-only with no hint of where to fix them.
findings.why: readonly() never calls has_error, and both values come from the profile, so the page gives no control to correct them.

options.name: Fix-in-profile link
options.detail: Show a 'Fix in profile' link beside Item 5 and Item 6 when either message applies.

options.name: Red read-only row
options.detail: Colour the read-only row red and place its message beside it.

options.name: Overridable field
options.detail: Let the filer correct Item 5 and Item 6 on the return, with the profile value as the default.

findings.now: Errors collect in a card below Schedule 1, showing only the first 20, while the Queue for submission button at the top is greyed out with no message beside it.
findings.why: The message sits far from the controls that cause it, and errors past the 20th are dropped without a count (take(20) at form_1600pt_view.rs:1188).

options.name: Inline messages
options.detail: Show each message under its field and keep the red label.

options.name: Summary under toolbar
options.detail: Show a count with jump links directly under the toolbar, above the sections.

options.name: Full list
options.detail: Drop the 20-message cap, or show 'and N more' when it applies.

findings.now: Twelve month buttons (Jan to Dec) fill a row of the Return period card and wrap onto several lines on a phone.
findings.why: Twelve options exceed the four-option threshold, and the official page uses a month select (BIR-Form1600PTv2018.hta:406).

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: A type-to-filter month list, which the rules recommend for more than four options.

options.name: Native select
options.detail: A dropdown of the twelve months, matching the official month select.

options.name: Segmented grid
options.detail: Four by three month chips that stay on one screen at every width.

findings.field: ATCs (tap to add or remove, at most five)
findings.now: Government filers see up to 31 ATC chips in one wrapped block (Private filers see 6), which is slow to scan on a phone.
findings.why: Picking up to five codes from a 31-item list is a search task, and chips cannot filter.

options.name: Multi-select combobox
options.detail: Filter by code or description, with each chosen ATC shown as a removable tag.

options.name: Chosen chips plus picker
options.detail: Show only the chosen ATCs as chips and open a filtered picker to add more.

options.name: Grouped chips
options.detail: Keep chips but group them by rate under collapsible headings.

findings.now: A malformed email shows 'Enter the email address BIR sends the filing confirmation to.' rather than the official alert.
findings.why: The official alert 'Please enter a valid e-mail address on page 1 item 10' (BIR-Form1600PTv2018.hta:3408) must appear verbatim, and this divergence is not noted on the page.

options.name: Use the official text
options.detail: Show the official alert verbatim, as the verbatim rule requires.

options.name: Record the deviation
options.detail: Keep the friendlier text and record the deviation in the form's rules notes.

options.name: Corrected item number
options.detail: Use the official wording with 'item 11' and flag it as a known deviation.

findings.now: The header titles and Print preview button this page renders come from components/form_engine.rs, which commit cdb1a9b4 changed together with the shared event_form_kit.rs and the 1601C and 2550Q pages.
findings.why: Shared-file edits beyond one-line registrations break the rule that a form's change touches only its own files.

options.name: Split the commit
options.detail: Ship the shared header change as its own reviewed commit.

options.name: Keep the header local
options.detail: Move this form's header into its own view file.

options.name: Drop other forms' edits
options.detail: Remove the 1601C, 2550Q and event_form_kit edits from this change and ship them separately.

findings.now: This form's Print preview depends on a frozen-sheet writer map added to shared bir-print code in commit 366af7e6, which also changed the 1606 model and view, the shared support-level registry and a generated manifest.
findings.why: A form's change should touch only its own files plus one-line registrations, and this commit goes well beyond that.

options.name: Split the commit
options.detail: Ship the 1606 changes and the shared frozen-sheet code as separate reviewed commits.

options.name: One-line registration
options.detail: Keep only this form's slug and writer-map arm in shared code, with the sheet map in its own html-frozen folder.

options.name: Revert the 1606 edits
options.detail: Drop the form_1606 changes from this commit and land them with 1606's own work.
